front.title: Causal Time Protocol (CTP/IP): Proof of Transformation Seal Verification and Wire Protocol

abstract.t:
This document describes how any party verifies a Proof of Transformation seal issued under the Causal Time Protocol (CTP/IP), and the wire protocol used to invoke a LUX Runtime and to request seal verification over a network. A seal attests that a transformation declared in advance by a Human Agency, through a signed Intention Signature (IntentSig), was validated by the LUX Runtime, and that the resulting certificate was committed to a Merkle batch anchored on the Solana and Bitcoin public ledgers.
The document specifies the certificate fields, the five layer verification procedure, the artifact identity check, the message types and envelope of the wire protocol, and the IANA registrations the protocol requests. It does not specify the measurement method by which a LUX Runtime computes the Coherence Index; that method is outside the scope of this document.
One seal attests intent, human origin, decision authority, authorship, substance, causal time and anchoring, for a Human Agency and for any agent acting under it. The protocol has been in development since 2020 and is deployed. Its canonical specification is published as Corpus Delta 1 under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21950371.
